decisions.reason: The indoor air quality sensor remains a promising low-cost sensing option with established fit, so it is kept open with only a modest chance of withdrawal.
As a core voltage measurement module with low uncertainty, it remains essential to the platform and is kept.
The MQTT proxy has very low keeping costs and remains a valuable connectivity option, so it is kept.
The CO2 sensor remains aligned with environmental sensing and cheap to keep, so it stays on the market.
The touch panel accessory has remained niche and after four years its value is unlikely to be realized, so it is dropped to free resources.
